title.narrative: Improved Land Policies for Sustainable and Equitable Land Governance

description.narrative: The project will be implemented by the Tanzania Land Alliance (TALA), a coalition of 14 civil society organizations working nationally and in rural communities across Tanzania, including Iringa, Dodoma, and Kilimanjaro. The project's main focus is to strengthen land tenure security for small-scale producers especially women, youth, pastoralists, and marginalized groups through improved land governance and stronger advocacy systems. The project aims to build capable organizations that protect community land rights and influence equitable land policies. Expected results include stronger TALA institutional capacity, improved national and local land governance frameworks, and increased community awareness of land and natural resource rights. Key activities include strategic planning, policy and legal reform engagement, national and regional multi-stakeholder dialogues, budget analysis, capacity building for CSOs and communities, legal support, land rights monitoring, and evidence-based advocacy. The project uses dialogue and advocacy as core strategies, supported by research, coordination platforms, and community-level capacity strengthening.
